question:
Which superhero has the same eyes, hair and skin colour? Indicate the publisher of the superhero.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: which superhero refers to superhero_name; the same eyes, hair and skin colour refers to hair_colour_id = skin_colour_id AND hair_colour_id = eye_colour_id; publisher refers to publisher_name;
